ce_notes_excerpt: Windows CE 1.0 and 1.01 only support a 2-bit gray scale palette, so GetSysColor returns a palette index rather than an RGB value. Windows Embedded CE graphic display interface (GDI) functions that accept a COLORREF structure can use either a palette index or an RGB value. Windows CE 2.0 supports 2 bits per pixel (2-bpp), 4 bits per pixel (4-bpp), and 8 bits per pixel (8-bpp) color devices, and can logically support 32 bits per pixel device independent bitmaps (DIBs). In Windows CE 2.0, GetSysColor returns an RGB value.
